shortBio.zh: Grohl 领衔的 alt-rock；1994 年后鼓手转主唱的职业路径。

body.en:
Started 1994 with Grohl playing most instruments on the debut; Nate Mendel, Pat Smear, and later Taylor Hawkins stabilized the live band. The Colour and the Shape (1997) fixed loud-quiet radio hooks.

Bridge node in this graph: Nirvana drummer → Foo Fighters frontman → Them Crooked Vultures. Musical constants—compressed guitars, stacked choruses, live reliability—matter more than mythology.
body.zh:
1994 起步，首专大半乐器由 Grohl 亲自演奏；Nate Mendel、Pat Smear 与后来的 Taylor Hawkins 稳定现场编制。The Colour and the Shape（1997）定型强弱电台钩子。

本图谱桥接节点：Nirvana 鼓手 → Foo Fighters 主唱 → Them Crooked Vultures。音乐常量——压缩吉他、堆叠副歌、现场稳定——重于神话。

whyMatters.en: Dave Grohl's post-Nirvana band; Foo Fighters (1995) onward turned a one-man demo project into a durable alternative/hard-rock touring act.
whyMatters.zh: Dave Grohl 在 Nirvana 之后的乐队；自同名专辑（1995）起把一人 demo 项目做成持久的 alternative/hard-rock 巡演编制。

note.en: Grohl-as-frontman debut—melodic verse, distorted chorus, one-man-demo origins.
note.zh: Grohl 主唱 debut——旋律主歌、失真副歌、一人 demo 起源。

note.en: Quiet-loud dynamic and open-chord arpeggio—Grohl's signature ballad-rager.
note.zh: Quiet-loud 动态与开放和弦琶音——Grohl 标志性抒情-爆发曲。

note.en: Delayed-entry riff and stacked gang vocals—stadium alt-rock peak.
note.zh: 延迟进入 riff 与堆叠齐唱——体育场 alt-rock 巅峰。

body.en:
Grohl records the Foo Fighters debut alone in Seattle after Nirvana ends. This Is a Call and Big Me show melodic hooks over punk-adjacent energy.

Pat Smear (ex-Nirvana touring guitarist) and Nate Mendel (Sunny Day Real Estate) join for touring. Grohl still writes and often records core tracks himself.

Foo Fighters (1995) establishes the template: verse melody, chorus distortion, no grunge costume.
body.zh:
Nirvana 结束后 Grohl 独自在西雅图录 Foo Fighters 首专。This Is a Call 与 Big Me 在朋克邻近能量上挂旋律钩子。

Pat Smear（Nirvana 巡演吉他）与 Nate Mendel（Sunny Day Real Estate）加入巡演。Grohl 仍自写并常自录核心轨。

Foo Fighters（1995）定模板：主歌旋律、副歌失真、无 grunge 戏服。

body.en:
Taylor Hawkins replaces William Goldsmith on drums mid-sessions. Everlong, Monkey Wrench, and My Hero define the loud-quiet FM standard.

Grohl and producer Gil Norton push guitar layering; Mendel's bass locks Hawkins' open hi-hat groove.

Album sells millions—cements Grohl as frontman, not just Nirvana drummer.
body.zh:
Taylor Hawkins 在录音中途替 William Goldsmith 打鼓。Everlong、Monkey Wrench、My Hero 定义 loud-quiet FM 标准。

Grohl 与制作人 Gil Norton 推吉他 layering；Mendel 贝斯锁 Hawkins 开放 hi-hat groove。

专辑销量数百万——巩固 Grohl 主唱身份，非仅 Nirvana 鼓手。

title.zh: 体育场时期与 supergroup 桥

body.en:
Chris Shiflett joins 1999; There Is Nothing Left to Lose through Echoes, Silence, Patience & Grace stack radio rock with Grohl's producer credit on QOTSA records.

Grohl drums on Queens of the Stone Age's Songs for the Deaf (2002); seeds Them Crooked Vultures (2009) with Homme and John Paul Jones.

Best of You and The Pretender prove sustained arena draw two decades post-Nirvana.
body.zh:
Chris Shiflett 1999 年加入；There Is Nothing Left to Lose 至 Echoes, Silence, Patience & Grace 堆叠电台摇滚，Grohl 任 QOTSA 唱片制作人。

Grohl 2002 年为 Queens of the Stone Age 的 Songs for the Deaf 打鼓；2009 年与 Homme、John Paul Jones 结出 Them Crooked Vultures。

Best of You 与 The Pretender 证明 Nirvana 后二十年仍有体育场号召力。
